4 temps par mesure pour presque toute la: 4 beats per bar for almost all of today's music; 3 for a waltz; 5 or 7 for odd, limping rhythms.
Accent : la note tape plus fort et plus: Accent: the note hits harder and brighter. Slide: it glides into the next one, typical of acid.
Associe un bouton ou un fader de ton con: Link a knob or fader on your controller to a setting: choose the setting, then turn the knob.
Branche un clavier en USB (il se connect: Plug in a keyboard over USB (it connects by itself) or search for it over Bluetooth.
Ce qui joue les notes de la piste. Synth: What plays the track's notes. Synth: a classic synth that makes its own sound. Plaits: a synth with 24 models. Sample: a recorded sound played across the whole keyboard (808s, basses, stabs from the packs). Instruments: 128 classic instruments (piano, strings…).
Comme la pédale du piano : les notes con: Like the piano pedal: notes keep ringing after you let go of the keys.
Comment le son démarre et s'éteint : l'a: How the sound starts and fades: the attack (the rise), the decay, the sustain (the level held) and the release (the end).
Coupe un son en morceaux, à chaque attaq: Cuts a sound into pieces at each hit, and puts each piece on a pad so you can play them back in another order.
Des effets à jouer en direct sur tout le: Effects to play live on the whole song: filter, repeat, tape stop, stutter.
Des sons déjà enregistrés (boucles, voix: Ready-recorded sounds (loops, vocals, bits of songs) that you start and stop with one tap, on top of your part. They stay locked to the tempo, like a DJ's.
Deux effets partagés par toutes les pist: Two effects shared by all tracks: the reverb makes it sound like a room, the echo repeats the sound. Each track sends more or less sound to them (its “send”).
Empêche la sortie générale de saturer qu: Keeps the main output from clipping when everything plays loud.
Fait monter ou descendre la note en glis: Bends the note up or down, then goes back to the centre when you let go.
L'appareil branché suit ton tempo, ton d: The connected device follows your tempo, your start and your stop.
L'appareil coupe le son dès que le micro: The device mutes the sound as soon as the mic starts, on every setting tried. Send me a screenshot of this page.
L'appareil émet un petit « pschht » et l: The device makes a little “pssht” and listens to it with its mic.
L'appli sépare une chanson en 4 pistes (: The app splits a song into 4 tracks (drums, bass, vocals, the rest) so you can play bits of it with your project.
L'écho naturel d'une pièce : petite sall: The natural echo of a room: small room, huge cathedral… The sound seems further away and wider.
La force d'un coup ou d'une note : plus: How hard a hit or note is played: the stronger, the harder it hits. In Rhythm, use the “Velocity” tool or long-press a square.
La grille des notes : de gauche à droite: The note grid: time goes left to right, pitch goes bottom to top. Tap to place a note, drag its end to make it longer.
La langue des claviers et des contrôleur: The language of keyboards and controllers: plug in a keyboard to play the app's instruments.
La note glisse vers la suivante au lieu: The note slides to the next one instead of jumping, when you hold a key and press another. The famous trap 808 effect.
La note à laquelle le son a été enregist: The note the sound was recorded at. The app finds it by itself; correct it if the sound plays out of tune.
La part du son d'une piste envoyée vers: How much of a track's sound is sent to the reverb or the echo, shared by all tracks.
La tonalité du morceau (par exemple La m: The song's key (for example A minor) and the chords that go with it. The keyboard shows the notes that sound right; locked, it plays only those.
La vitesse du morceau, en battements par: The speed of the song, in beats per minute. Around 90: laid-back hip-hop; 125: house; 174: drum & bass.
Le haut-parleur n'a pas pu démarrer. Rée: The speaker couldn't start. Try again in a few seconds.
Le micro n'entend que du silence absolu: The mic hears only total silence: mic access is probably turned off in the quick settings (Mic icon).
Le micro ne livre aucun son malgré plusi: The mic delivers no sound despite several settings tried. Run the measurement again: the app keeps trying other settings.
Le micro refuse de s'ouvrir. Vérifie que: The mic won't open. Check that mic access is allowed for BenStudio, and that no other app is using it (call, dictation).
Le métronome fait un petit clic sur chaq: The metronome clicks on every beat to help you play in time; it's never heard in the export. The count-in adds a bar of clicks before the start, to get ready.
Le petit retard entre ton toucher et le: The short delay between your touch and the sound. The lower it is, the better you can play live.
Le son de la Roland TB-303 qui a fait na: The sound of the Roland TB-303 that gave birth to acid house: a bass that squelches when you open the filter.
Le son est étiré ou resserré pour durer: The sound is stretched or squeezed to last exactly the chosen number of beats, even if you change the tempo.
Le son que joue le pad quand on le touch: The sound the pad plays when you tap it. A “sample” is a recorded sound that gets played back: a kick, a voice, a bit of a song. Take one from the library, import one or record one with the mic; without a sample, the pad plays the drum machine's sound.
Le son recommence tout seul, calé sur le: The sound starts over by itself, locked to the tempo, until you stop it. “Once” plays it just once per tap.
Le son se répète en rythme, de plus en p: The sound repeats in time, softer and softer.
Le temps entre ton doigt et tes oreilles: The time between your finger and your ears. Goal: under 20 ms.
Le volume tel que l'oreille le ressent,: Loudness as the ear feels it, measured the way Spotify or YouTube do. Around −14: streaming level; closer to 0: louder.
Le volume, la place gauche-droite et les: The volume, left-right position and effects of each track, plus the main output.
Les 16 sons de la batterie ensemble. Cha: The 16 drum sounds together. Changing the kit changes all the pads at once.
Les 7 notes qui vont bien ensemble, par: The 7 notes that sound good together, for example C major (happy) or A minor (sadder). The keyboard shows the ones that sound right.
Les notes d'un accord jouées une par une: The notes of a chord played one by one, going up or down, in time with the song.
Les notes hors de la gamme ne jouent plu: Notes outside the scale no longer play: no wrong notes possible.
Les notes jouent le Synthé. Sur le canal: Notes play the Synth. On channel 10, notes %1$s to %2$s (36 to 51) hit the 16 pads.
Les pads d'un même groupe se coupent ent: Pads in the same group cut each other off, like the closed hi-hat stopping the open one.
Les parties mises bout à bout, chacune r: The parts put end to end, each repeated as many times as you like. In the timeline, each square turns a track on or off in one part.
Mesure interrompue : l'appli est passée: Measurement interrupted: the app went to the background.
Monte ou baisse les graves, les médiums: Raises or lowers the lows, mids and highs of a sound.
Monte ou descend le son, en demi-tons, c: Raises or lowers the sound, in semitones, like going from one key to the next on a keyboard. +12 = one octave higher.
Montre la note que tu chantes ou joues,: Shows the note you're singing or playing, and how far too high or too low it is.
Montre où est l'énergie du son : les gra: Shows where the sound's energy is: lows on the left, highs on the right.
Moteur audio indisponible sur cet appare: Audio engine unavailable on this device.
Muet coupe la piste. Solo n'écoute qu'el: Mute silences the track. Solo plays only that one (and the other soloed tracks).
Place le son à gauche ou à droite dans l: Places the sound left or right in your headphones. In the centre, it's on both sides.
Plusieurs copies du son, très légèrement: Several copies of the sound, very slightly detuned, played together: the sound becomes wide and bright. It's the “supersaw” of trance and future bass, and the Reese bass of drum & bass.
Plusieurs coups rapides dans une seule c: Several quick hits in a single square (2, 3 or 4), for rapid-fire hi-hats or build-ups.
Plusieurs notes jouées ensemble, souvent: Several notes played together, often three. They give the song its colour: happy, sad, mysterious…
Quatre gros réglages par piste : Couleur: Four big controls per track: Colour (dark or bright), Dirt (distortion), Motion (chorus) and Space (reverb and echo).
Rapproche les passages forts et faibles: Brings loud and quiet parts closer together: the sound is tighter and more present.
Recale exactement sur la grille les note: Snaps notes played slightly off exactly onto the grid.
Rend le son plus sourd (fermé) ou plus b: Makes the sound duller (closed) or brighter (open). Resonance makes it whistle around its frequency.
Retarde un peu un pas sur deux : le ryth: Delays every other step a little: the rhythm sways instead of being square.
Seulement les notes, sans le son : un au: Just the notes, without the sound: other software can play them back with its own instruments.
Signal trop faible pour être repéré. Vol: Signal too weak to detect. Media volume all the way up, device lying flat on a table, and try again.
Tempo, départ et arrêt viennent de l'aut: Tempo, start and stop come from the other machine (drum machine, computer…).
Touche un réglage puis tourne un bouton: Tap a setting, then turn a knob on your controller: that knob will control the setting.
Tous les sons de l'appli rangés par fami: All the app's sounds sorted by family (kick, snare, bass…): the built-in sounds and those from downloaded packs.
Tout le morceau mélangé, tel qu'il sort: The whole song mixed together, as it comes out of the device. Its limiter keeps it from clipping when everything plays loud.
Un carré qu'on touche et où l'on glisse: A square you tap and slide your finger on: it controls two macros at once, one per direction.
Un des 16 carrés de la batterie. Chacun: One of the 16 drum squares. Each has its own sound (kick, snare, hi-hat…), which you can change.
Un effet branché directement sur une pis: An effect plugged straight into a track: distortion, filter, compressor… Up to four per track.
Un fichier par piste (batterie, basse, s: One file per track (drums, bass, synth…), to keep working on the song in other software.
Un groupe de temps, en général 4 (« 1, 2: A group of beats, usually 4 (“1, 2, 3, 4”). The drum grid shows one bar cut into 16 squares.
Un instrument électronique qui fabrique: An electronic instrument that makes its own sound (oscillators, filter) instead of playing back a recording.
Un moment du morceau (Intro, Couplet, Dr: A moment of the song (Intro, Verse, Drop…): it plays a block for a few bars. The song chains the parts, from start to end.
Un réglage qui bouge tout seul pendant l: A setting that moves by itself during playback: the volume rising, the filter opening… You draw it point by point.
Un réglage tout prêt (Sous l'eau, Lo-Fi: A ready-made setting (Underwater, Lo-Fi Tape, Huge cathedral…) that applies several effects at once.
Un son enregistré joué sur tout le clavi: A recorded sound played across the whole keyboard: the higher the key, the higher it goes. Great for 808s, basses and stabs from the packs.
Un synthé aux 24 modèles (cordes, cloche: A synth with 24 models (strings, bells, FM, voices, percussion…), based on a famous synth module.
Une IA fabrique un son à partir d'une ph: An AI makes a sound from a sentence (“dark techno kick”), right on the device.
Une banque de 128 instruments classiques: A bank of 128 classic instruments (piano, guitar, strings, brass…), downloaded once.
Une case de la grille : un seizième de m: One square of the grid: a sixteenth of a bar. Turning a step on plays the sound at that moment. Hits: on or off. Rolls: several quick hits in the square. Pan: left or right. Pitch: higher or lower.
Une case de la ligne de basse : une note: One square of the bass line: a note or a rest. Accent: it hits harder and brighter. Slide: it glides into the next one.
Une collection de sons pour un style (te: A collection of sounds for a style (techno, UK garage, trap…), a famous machine (TR-808, Juno, DX7…) or current sounds. Download only if you want, and delete whenever you like.
Une colonne par partie du morceau, une l: One column per part of the song, one row per track: a lit square, the track plays in that part; off, it stays silent.
Une ligne du morceau avec son propre ins: A line of the song with its own instrument and notes: the bass, the pad, the lead… Each one has its own channel in the mixer.
Une mesure de clics avant le départ, pou: A bar of clicks before the start, to get ready to play or record.
Une note pure pour vérifier que le moteu: A pure note to check that the audio engine sounds right.
Une piste qui joue un enregistrement (mi: A track that plays a recording (microphone or file): once each time its part comes round, or from start to finish of the song. Record with headphones on.
Une suite d'accords qui tourne en boucle: A sequence of chords that loops, like I–V–vi–IV, found in hundreds of songs.
WAV : qualité studio, lu partout, mais l: WAV: studio quality, plays everywhere, but heavy. FLAC: exactly the same quality, much lighter (often half the size). M4A: about ten times lighter, for sharing.
la connexion est trop lente ou a coupé: the connection is too slow or dropped
